tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// slob dpon pad+ma'i gsol 'debs bsam pa myur 'grub ma bzhugs// na maḥsarba bud+dha bo dhi satwā ya/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi sprul pa'i sku// mkhyen brtse nus ldan gu ru rin po che// lho nub rnga yab gling phran dpal ri yi// pad+ma 'od nas da lta gnas 'dir byon// steng gi cha la rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*// bar gyi cha la yi dam zhi khro'i tshogs// 'og gi cha la bka' srung mkha' 'gro rnams// bu yug 'tshubs ltar mngon sum gsal bar bzhugs// bdag gzhan lus srog longs spyod dus gsum gyi// dge tshogs mchod sprin nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa// yid kyi sprul nas mchod yul rnams la 'bul// rgyun chad med par spyan lam 'byung gyur cig /deng sang gangs can ljongs 'di'i 'gro 'di rnams// las ngan bsags pa'i 'bras bu dus la smin// smra shes don go mi yi lus thob kyang*// ngan song sdug bsngal lta bus gzir la gzigs// tsha grang srog bral dmyal ba'i yul ljongs bzhin// bkres skom sdug bsngal yi dwags lus dang mtshungs// bsad spyad bkol spyod dud 'gro ltar myong ba'i// 'gro ba 'di rnams thugs rjes myur du skyobs// gzhan dma' 'bebs phyir g.yo sgyu khram gsum gyi// 'khrug long ma lus zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// chags sdang dbang gis dus 'khrugs 'di zhi nas// so sor rang dbang thob par byin= /rgyal po rnams kyis chos bzhin sa skyong zhing*// 'bangs rnams bka' bzhin sgrub par= /bstan 'dzin thams cad sku tshe legs brtan cing*// gzhan don lhun gyis 'grub par= /dge 'dun rnams kyang 'chad nyan spel ba dang*// bstan pa ris med dar bar= /sgrub pa po rnams g.yeng bas ma gos pa'i// ting 'dzin las su rung bar= /yul phyogs kun tu char chu dus su 'babs// lo phyugs rtag tu legs par= /mi nad phyugs nad dus 'khrugs rgyun chad nas// rgyal khams bde bas 'tsho bar=

/stobs ldan rnams kyi rgyud la ngan sems kyis// 'jig rten phung sems zhi bar= /ci ste las ngan dbang gis phung g.yos kyang*// nus med rang zhir 'gyur bar= /bka' srung rnams kyi'ang gzhan gyis ma bskul yang*// gdug can dngos su sgrol bar= /skye bo 'di kun ngo tsha khrel yod kyis// gcig sems gcig gis 'dzin par= /phan tshun byams sems g.yo med rab brten pas// kun gyis bde thabs sgrub par= /de la brten nas ljongs 'di'i 'gro ba rnams// bde skyid dpal la spyod par= /kun kyang chog shes rtsod med mnga' ris kyi// bstan dang bstan 'dzin mchod par= /'byung po rnams kyang gdug rtsub kun zhi nas// 'gro la brtse sems skye bar= /mdor na gzugs can gzugs med 'gro ba kun// shes rgyud chos dang mthun par= /de la brten nas phyi ma lhan cig par// bde ba can du skye bar= /nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i gu ru rin po che// 'khor bcas rang la thim pa'i byin rlabs kyis// slob dpon chen po'i lung rtogs yon tan dang*// rang nyid nus pa mnyam par byin gyis rlobs// bdag gis 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal ma bzod pas// bdag cag byas med yus kyi gdung shugs kyis// bdag nyid chen po khyed la gsol btab pas// bdag gzhan don kun yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig /ces slob dpon rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas la thugs rje myur bskul gsol 'debs bsam pa myur 'grub bod khams kun tu bde ba'i dpal ster zhes bya ba 'di'ang sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen paṇ+ḍi ta sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis lcags mo sbrul lor dbus gtsang gi ljongs 'dir dus ngan gyi 'khrug long sna tshogs byung dus skye 'gro rnams bde la 'god pa zhig byung na snyam pa'i lhag bsam rnam par dag pas kun nas bslangs te hor zla bcu pa'i dkar phyogs rdzogs pa gnyis pa'i tshes la dge sdings chos kyi pho brang chen por legs par sbyar ba 'dis kyang bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig/

// ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
